description: This file contains shell functions related to system upgrade and image handling on Tegra-based Linux systems, including partition management, image extraction, and bootloader updates.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the partition layout of a given image against the current device to determine if an update is needed.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration backups to the mounted partition during upgrade.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the system upgrade by writing images to the disk, updating bootloader, and partitions based on specified conditions.
